source_refs.note: i) Hypothesis: a main subheading of 14.12 Experiments and data collection to test a hypothesis about air quality, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 317-317.

blocks.text: As a first step, a hypothesis is developed to design an experiment. For example, the hypothesis, “The concentration of airborne particulate matters (PM 2.5) and nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) in urban areas is higher during peak traffic hours as compared to non-peak hours” can be tested by collecting air quality data at different time of the day.
